podcast.body: This debut album was not a commercial success, reaching no higher than #164 on the Billboard Top 200 albums chart. Despite its poor sales, it profoundly influenced other musicians like Glenn Frey of the Eagles and is considered historically significant for its impact on descendants such as Poco, The Eagles, The Rolling Stones, and Tom Petty & The Heartbreakers. "The first album from the burritos, Gilded Palace of Sin, was not a commercial success. In fact, very few of the country rock albums were."
